faqs.question: How can I get into Ganadipathy Tulsi's Jain Engineering College for UG/PG courses? Am I eligible for admission?
faqs.answer:
Ganadipathy Tulsi's Jain Engineering College has below criteria for taking admissions to it's various courses:
Courses Eligibility
B.E. / B.Tech Candidate must have passed VIII, IX, X, XI & XII Std. from schools situated in Tamil Nadu. Tamil Nadu native candidate who have passed any of the VIII, IX, X, XI & XII Std. or their equivalent exam from schools situated outside Tamil Nadu can also apply. They should produce Original Nativity Certificate. Children of Central Government Employees, irrespective of their nativity, provided their parents or guardians (only if both parents are not alive) have been serving in Tamil Nadu continuously for the past five years can be eligible to apply. Sons & daughters of All India service Tamil Nadu cadre officers are eligible to apply. A Self declaration from the parent in this regard is to be produced. Children of employees in the Public Sector or Government recognised institutions had been working in their organisations for the past five years are also eligible, irrespective of their domicile. Other State candidates who have studied VIII, IX, X, XI and XII Std. in Tamil Nadu are eligible to apply.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Our college is good but it is situated in rural area.

review_content.Placements: Our college is average but our department students get placed mostly. around 77% of students got placed. The highest salary package was 12 LPA and the lowest salary package was 1.8 LPA. Top recruiting companies are HCL and Accenture.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have a very good lab facility with a good Wi-Fi connection. Classrooms are good and have a very good library facility. Canteen should be improved. Sports and games are average.
review_content.Faculty: Teachers are good, well talented, and well qualified. Their way of teaching is excellent. We get lots of knowledge from them. The course teaches the students based on the work they are going to work in industries. Semester exams are a little difficult. The pass percentage is 80%.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2016
reviews_list.review_title: I am not satisfied because of placements training and support for 2016.

review_content.Placements: There were no placements training and no placements opportunity. They asked to join with VIT consortium for placements. In competition there were like 100 vacancies and there were 3000 candidates without proper guidance and most of cannot make it. There were not much in placements cell.
review_content.Infrastructure: This college provides a library and a digital library. Wi-Fi was there but of no use for students. The passwords were not available. Laboratories were like the same with old equipment it was running. The hostel was there for both boys and girls. It provides a cafeteria for snacks and lunch. Sports events were held very rare. Medical facility was available, one doctor was available in this college.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: Our college is a good place to learn.

review_content.Placements: Placements in our college are good. The highest salary package offered is 8 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 4 LPA. A maximum number of students got an internship at the college. Top roles are not offered to the students.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good. It is a good place. Our college provides free Wi-Fi facility. The library is good, and you can find many different books there. Food served to the students is somewhat good. Facilities available in our college are good. There is nothing special about sports.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2019
reviews_list.review_title: This college was good, but the commitment of students and faculty is poor.

review_content.Placements: Placements in our college are very good for IT and CSE departments but not for the mechanical and civil departments. The companies that visit the campus offer a low salary package for students. Very few good companies visit the campus to hire students. Placements are not worthful here. The college needs to work on its placements.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very good. There are trees on both sides of the path that laid from the entrance to the canteen. Classrooms are very good here. Even the library facilities are good. However, the college provides good Wi-Fi facility for students. They don't even provide any medical facilities. As far as the medical facilities are concerned, they only provide the first aid equipment. Lab facilities provided here are good, and many machines are not even in working condition.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely dissatisfied of sports and really awesome environment and good teaching.

review_content.Infrastructure: In my college, good coaches and teachers are there for all students and they also teach the manner of life. Digital library are available in our college. reviews.review_heading: Review of Shri Vithal Education and Research Institute's College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college was very good. Classrooms are huge and spacious. The library and study rooms are very good. There is an auditorium in the centre of the college. Classrooms, labs and college office are well-furnished. There is a huge playground on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very strict college, and it is like a school.

There is a separate seminar hall for each department. There is a huge playground for playing various games. I was quite unhappy with Wi-Fi facility, and the network was poor.

reviews.review_text: Poor infrastructure and dirty hostel. No proper medical facilities for students. No separate building for separate departments. Unnecessary fine collected from students. In name of discipline. In period of submission students are harassed by teachers.

reviews.review_heading: The teaching system in our college is good.

Quality of the food is good. The mess is good, and there are 4 messes in our college. There are small hospitals, and sports and games are good.
